numerical_failure.affected_api: astropy.io.fits.hdu.compressed.compressed (CompImageHDU reading of integer compressed images with BLANK/ZBLANK; module astropy/io/fits/hdu/compressed/compressed.py)
numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Integer compressed images with blanks are not handled correctly: the image datatype is converted to float or uint before blank values are tested, so the BLANK comparison fails (e.g. for uint16 the negative BLANK value -32768 no longer matches); the conversion to NaN for blanks only happened when BZERO/BSCALE were also specified, and a spurious exception was raised when reading such images.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Blank pixels should be detected first (against the BLANK or ZBLANK value, before datatype conversion) and then the image converted, so integer compressed images with BLANK or ZBLANK (or both) are read as float images with NaN in place of blanks, even when BZERO and BSCALE are not defined, consistent with uncompressed image HDUs.
trigger_conditions: Integer compressed image (ZBITPIX > 0) containing blank pixels
Header specifies BLANK or ZBLANK (or both)
Reading the compressed image without BZERO/BSCALE keywords
Unsigned integer types where the blank comparison happens after conversion to uint

input_output_examples.buggy_output: blank comparison fails after conversion to uint16; spurious exception raised on read
input_output_examples.expected_output: float image with NaN at blank pixels

category_specific_evidence: Blank test must happen before conversion of integer image to float or uint, since comparing to BLANK after conversion is incorrect for float types (BLANK may not be exactly representable as float64) and definitely incorrect for unsigned types.
Example: BLANK of -32768 for int16 image fails if image already converted to uint16; new code tests blanks first then converts.
np.where(blanks, np.nan, data) converts uint data to float to hold NaN; coercing to np.float32(np.nan) keeps float32 output where possible.
np.where yields float64 for uint32 and uint64 sizes, keeping uint and int dtype paths consistent when converted to float.
Integer compressed images with BLANK or ZBLANK should be converted to float with NaN for blanks, even without BZERO/BSCALE, consistent with uncompressed HDUs.
Per the tile compression spec, ZBLANK should not be set on integer HDUs (ZBITPIX > 0); BLANK should be used instead.
reproduction_risks: Blank comparison done after uint conversion yields wrong results for negative BLANK values such as -32768.
Output dtype depends on uint size: float32 vs float64 result.
Test reference data (m13.fits subset 116:180) and NaN injection at indices [1,2,3] are from test code, not verified numerical expectations.
Special values are NaN only as blanks; no evidence on +/-inf, signed zero, or subnormals.
